summary: Master high-end event management for HNWI clients. Learn bespoke design, elite service standards, and security protocols. Enroll for expert-led training.
lede: Bespoke luxury event planning combines guest-focused design with the logistics and service needed for premium celebrations. It is intended for event managers, VIP relations professionals, lifestyle managers and premium brand specialists who plan high-profile gatherings. Coursework covers sensory-mapped guest journeys, vendor sourcing and negotiation, privacy-conscious guest communication, security planning and budget modeling.
audienceIntro: This program is curated for professionals who operate at the intersection of high-stakes logistics and premium hospitality.
audience: High-Net-Worth Individual (HNWI) Lifestyle Managers and Concierges
Premium Brand Activation Specialists focused on luxury
Creative Directors for premium fashion and jewelry
outcomes: Event Security And Privacy Protocol Design
modules: The Luxury Landscape and HNWI Psychology
Bespoke Experience Design and Sensory Mapping
Elite Vendor Management and Strategic Sourcing
Sustainability and ESG in the Luxury Sector
prerequisites: Participants should have at least 3-5 years of experience in event coordination or hospitality management. Familiarity with basic project management tools and a fundamental understanding of the luxury market are recommended. No specific technical prerequisites are required, though a laptop is necessary for budget modeling and design exercises.
